text:
I found 11 problems. The three that matter most are the Bing block, the client-only changelog, and the missing sitemap line.

## High impact

1. **`public/robots.txt:5-6` blocks Bingbot entirely.**
   - This contradicts `geo.config.json`, which says AI search crawlers should be allowed.
   - Bing's index feeds Copilot, and ChatGPT search and others draw on it.
   - Fix: delete the `Bingbot` block. The `*` rule already allows everything except `/dashboard`.

2. **`app/routes/changelog.tsx:4-6` renders its content only on the client.**
   - The entries load in `useEffect` from `/api/changelog`, so the server HTML has an empty `<ul>`.
   - Most AI crawlers don't run JavaScript, so they see no content.
   - Fix: use a Remix `loader` and `useLoaderData`, so the entries are in the server HTML.
   - There is also no `app/routes/api.changelog.tsx`, so that endpoint doesn't exist in this repo.

3. **`public/robots.txt` has no `Sitemap:` line.**
   - Fix: add `Sitemap: https://atlasroadmaps.example/sitemap.xml`.

4. **`app/routes/pricing.tsx:1` has no `meta` export.**
   - The page has no title, description or canonical tag.
   - It falls back to the generic title and description in `app/root.tsx:2`, and may be treated as a duplicate of other pages.
   - Fix: add a unique title, description and canonical `https://atlasroadmaps.example/pricing`.
   - The copy "Talk to us for a quote" gives nothing concrete to cite. Add actual plan names and prices, and `Product`/`Offer` JSON-LD.

## Medium impact

5. **`public/robots.txt:8-9` blocks only GPTBot.**
   - `geo.config.json` says to block training crawlers, but only one is covered.
   - Fix: add `Disallow: /` for `ClaudeBot`, `anthropic-ai`, `Google-Extended`, `CCBot`, `Applebot-Extended` and `Bytespider`.
   - Don't block `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot` or `Claude-SearchBot`. They are search and retrieval crawlers.
   - Consider listing those search crawlers explicitly with `Allow: /`, so the policy is visible.

6. **`app/routes/_index.tsx:9` uses a `<div onClick>` for navigation.**
   - Crawlers don't follow it, so `/features` gets no internal link from the home page. It's also not keyboard accessible.
   - Fix: replace it with `<Link to="/features">See all features</Link>`.

7. **`app/root.tsx:7` is the only place the site links to pages, and it omits `/features` (and the home page).**
   - The nav has only Pricing and Changelog.
   - Fix: add Home and Features, and use `<Link>`.

8. **The copy is vague, so there is little for an AI answer to quote.**
   - `app/routes/_index.tsx:8` says "Integrates with all the tools you already use." and names no tools.
   - `app/routes/features.tsx:1` is one generic sentence.
   - Fix: name the integrations and describe each feature in a few sentences, with `<h2>` sections.
   - Add FAQ content with `FAQPage` JSON-LD.

## Lower impact

9. **No structured data anywhere.**
   - Add `Organization` and `WebSite` JSON-LD in `app/root.tsx`, and `SoftwareApplication` on the home page.

10. **`public/sitemap.xml:3-6` has no `<lastmod>` values.**
    - Add them, especially for `/changelog`, which changes often.

11. **`app/root.tsx:2` has weak default metadata, and there are no social tags.**
    - The default title is just "Atlas".
    - Per-page `meta` exports replace the root's, so `og:*` and `twitter:*` tags would need to be repeated on each page.
    - Fix: add `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image` and `og:type` to each page's `meta`. Also add a viewport meta tag, and a charset tag in `<head>`.

## Checked and fine
- `app/routes/dashboard.tsx:1` uses `noindex`, and `/dashboard` is disallowed in robots.txt and absent from the sitemap. One caveat: because robots.txt blocks crawling, crawlers can't see the `noindex`. That's acceptable here.
- Canonicals on the home, features and changelog pages match the sitemap URLs.
- `<html lang="en">` is set.
- Every page has an `<h1>`.

I haven't changed any files. I can apply these fixes if you want.
